targets.query:
from(bucket: "nbomber")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /nbomber.*/ or r["_measurement"] == "stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "ok_count" or r["_field"] == "rps" or r["_field"] == "request_count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
